relationships.subject: HRS-2129
relationships.evidence_quote: HRS-2129 is a novel, orally administered, selective Nav1.8 sodium channel blocker under development for pain management.

relationships.subject: HRS-2129
relationships.evidence_quote: PD results showed increased pain tolerance time in the ice-water bath test without clear dose dependency.

relationships.subject: HRS-2129
relationships.evidence_quote: One SAE (drug rash) led to discontinuation in the 75 mg QD cohort during the MAD phase.

key_findings: In first-in-human SAD (25-600 mg) and MAD studies, HRS-2129 was well tolerated; dose-limiting drug rash at 75 mg QD set 25 mg BID as maximum safe dose.
PK showed rapid absorption and a 28-35 h half-life supporting once-daily dosing; ice-water pain tolerance time increased, consistent with Nav1.8 target engagement.
